about: Capability registry: what the studio can use, how mature it is, what it is for. Read by lib/capabilities.mjs and `node studio.mjs`. Maturity: CORE (stable default) > PRODUCTION (tests + several films) > PROVEN (one film or a passing study) > EXPERIMENTAL (study only) > PLANNED (decided, not built) > LEARN (study its ideas; no dependency). Add a capability only with a check and, from EXPERIMENTAL up, a study.

core.about: Required for every film: Node >= 22, Chrome/Chromium, FFmpeg + ffprobe. Install manually.

vision.about: Reference forensics: shot detection, optical flow, easing curves.

audio.about: Music analysis: tempo, beats, key, sections.

live.about: Real footage of people: mattes, tracking, VAD, speech. Then download models: python tools/live.py models (~1.4 GB).

gpu.about: Browser 3D and GPU 2D engines, vendored into studio/vendor (git-ignored), pinned.

color.about: Professional color/image libraries for a future EXR/OCIO route. Installed tools only; no studio adapter yet.

pro.about: External desktop applications. Never auto-downloaded; install from the official site when a film needs them.

capabilities.name: Native composer: DOM + SVG + CSS
capabilities.bestFor: typography (Arabic shaping), UI, product stills, logos, layouts, layered 2.5D

capabilities.name: Canvas 2D in the composer
capabilities.bestFor: seeded particle fields up to a few thousand, procedural textures, grids
capabilities.avoidFor: text that must be read back (use .line/.word DOM)

capabilities.name: PixiJS 8 (GPU 2D)
capabilities.bestFor: tens of thousands of sprites/particles, 2D filters
capabilities.avoidFor: readable text and simple layouts (DOM is simpler)
capabilities.note: import from 'pixi.js' (composer import map). Study: 20,000 particles, identical pixels across separate runs (2026-10-03). Needs config.gpu: true; await app.init with autoStart:false, call app.render() in render(t).

capabilities.name: WebGL2 shaders (lib/gpu.js)
capabilities.bestFor: procedural gradients, distortion, glow with explicit uniforms

capabilities.name: Three.js (browser 3D)
capabilities.bestFor: real 3D objects, materials, lights, orbiting cameras, glTF products
capabilities.note: import from 'three' / 'three/addons/…' (composer import map). Study: metallic bottle, PMREM room light, identical pixels across runs (2026-10-03). Needs config.gpu: true (software WebGL): keep scenes modest; heavy realism belongs to Blender.

capabilities.name: Blender 5.2 LTS (external renderer)
capabilities.bestFor: photoreal products, simulation (cloth, fluid, smoke), heavy lighting
capabilities.avoidFor: anything Three.js or DOM can do
capabilities.note: Bridge = render a PNG/video sequence through lib/engines.mjs or as a footage layer (lib/footage.js). Not built yet.

capabilities.name: Footage layers (lib/footage.js)
capabilities.bestFor: real video, mattes, graphics behind/in front of people, pre-rendered external shots

capabilities.name: Live-action analysis (tools/live.py)
capabilities.bestFor: person mattes, face/pose anchors, VAD, transcripts, 9:16 reframe

capabilities.name: Real app capture (lib/app-capture.mjs)
capabilities.bestFor: filming a real product UI with verified values

capabilities.name: UI motion kits (lib/uimotion.js, lib/uimorph.js)
capabilities.bestFor: product promos, container morphs, cursor narration, logo assembly

capabilities.name: Camera + depth (lib/cinema.js, lib/depth.js)
capabilities.bestFor: one shared camera, parallax, rack focus

capabilities.name: Synthesised score + SFX (lib/audio.mjs, lib/sfx.mjs)
capabilities.bestFor: original music and foley on picture cues, no licence needed

capabilities.name: FFmpeg (encode, mix, measure)
capabilities.bestFor: every encode, cut, mux, loudness and measurement

capabilities.name: Music analysis (librosa)
capabilities.bestFor: tempo/beat/section maps of licensed tracks

capabilities.name: Reference reverse-engineering + artistic forensics
capabilities.bestFor: learning a supplied film's grammar and Artistic DNA (ARTISTIC_FORENSICS.md)

capabilities.name: Motion/easing/cut forensics (OpenCV, PySceneDetect)
capabilities.bestFor: measured keyframes, easing, cuts of a reference

capabilities.name: Logo tracer (tools/logo_trace.py)
capabilities.bestFor: vector parts + particle targets from a raster logo

capabilities.name: OpenTimelineIO export (lib/edl.mjs)
capabilities.bestFor: handing a cut to Resolve/Premiere
capabilities.note: Known defect (audit B05): gaps, speed and audio offsets are not exported. Do not promise an exact handoff yet.

capabilities.name: OpenColorIO / OpenImageIO / OpenEXR
capabilities.bestFor: managed color and EXR passes for a future Blender/3D route
capabilities.note: Browser films are SDR Rec.709 by contract; no adapter yet.

capabilities.name: Browser session: attach to a launcher-started Chrome (STUDIO_CDP_URL)
capabilities.bestFor: machines where Chrome must be started by an approved launcher: the studio uses an isolated browser context and never starts/kills the browser
capabilities.note: Default stays private headless Chrome. Verified 2026-10-03 against a test Chrome on port 9333: renders, owner tabs untouched, context disposed. Pixels differ from private mode (42 dB PSNR): one film = one mode (cache key includes the mode).

capabilities.name: Colour management (lib/color.mjs, tools/ocio_bake.py)
capabilities.bestFor: proving the sRGB → BT.709 export contract (ΔE chart), scopes, legal range, optional .cube grade (config.lut) baked by OpenColorIO
capabilities.note: Measured 2026-10-03: ΔE mean 0.70 / max 1.22 (dither: 0.54 / 1.07) — invisible. Scopes in every review build; legal range in the measurement pass.

capabilities.name: Playback review player (node studio.mjs review)
capabilities.bestFor: watching the real export: frame stepping, shot/cue/copy timeline, waveform, A/B takes, timed notes, approval bound to the file's SHA-256

capabilities.name: Canonical transcript (lib/transcript.mjs)
capabilities.bestFor: one transcript driving edits, captions (SRT/VTT/ASS/TXT/JSON), translation layers, search, fillers, repeats, cut points
capabilities.note: Mixed Arabic/English recognised per phrase; word timing is estimated inside Whisper segments (not forced alignment); confidence is not provided by the decoder.

capabilities.name: Speech recognition + diarization (tools/live.py: Silero VAD, Whisper turbo, pyannote + ERes2Net)
capabilities.bestFor: offline Arabic/English/mixed transcription and who-speaks-when
capabilities.note: Models: python tools/live.py models --asr=turbo --tts=1 --diar=1. Test 2026-10-03: Arabic + English sentences both recognised with --lang=auto; diarization merged two similar synthetic male voices (2 of 3 speakers).

capabilities.name: Windows built-in voices (Hoda ar-EG, David/Zira en-US)
capabilities.bestFor: offline drafts: animatic timing in Egyptian Arabic and English

capabilities.name: Local Piper voice via sherpa-onnx (kareem ar_JO)
capabilities.bestFor: offline deterministic scratch voice

capabilities.name: Cloud voices: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, ElevenLabs, Azure ar-EG neural (lib/voice.mjs adapters)
capabilities.bestFor: production narration with performance direction; Azure ar-EG Salma/Shakir for native Egyptian
capabilities.note: Adapters follow the public REST APIs but are UNVERIFIED until run with OPENAI_API_KEY / ELEVENLABS_API_KEY / AZURE_SPEECH_KEY+REGION. Never required: offline voices always work.

capabilities.name: Mix QA (lib/mixcheck.mjs)
capabilities.bestFor: clipping, mono fold-down, phone-speaker survival, stereo phase in one pass

capabilities.name: Sound library (sounds/library.json)
capabilities.bestFor: finding music/SFX/room tone with source and rights; synth entries are original

capabilities.name: Source separation (Demucs-class: speech / music / effects)
capabilities.bestFor: pulling dialogue out of a mixed track
capabilities.note: Needs PyTorch (not installed). Never claim perfect separation; keep the original track.

capabilities.name: WebCodecs / Mediabunny
capabilities.bestFor: possible faster Canvas → video path; benchmark before adopting

capabilities.name: HyperFrames (HeyGen)
capabilities.bestFor: ideas: seekable adapters for GSAP/Lottie/Three, agent skills routing
capabilities.note: lib/engines.mjs can run any external renderer that writes a silent video.

capabilities.name: Remotion
capabilities.bestFor: data-driven batches (100 products → 100 videos)

capabilities.name: Motion Canvas
capabilities.bestFor: ideas for explainer/diagram timelines

capabilities.name: Lottie / Rive runtimes
capabilities.bestFor: importing designer-made vector loops; seek with goToAndStop
